channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: What Will The Kings And Oilers Do At The Trade Deadline?
item.description: A season-ending injury to Kevin Fiala could send the Los Angeles Kings back into the trade market, while speculation abounds over whether the Edmonton Oilers will pursue a forward or a defenseman by the NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Do Not Overlook Switzerland In The Olympic Knockout Stages
item.description: With a secret weapon who never played in the NHL, a coach who instilled new confidence into the national program and extra motivation to medal, watch out for Team Switzerland in the Olympic knockout stages.

item.title: Could Canadiens' Nick Suzuki Leave Canada's Lineup For Brad Marchand?
item.description: Brad Marchand is set to rejoin Canada's lineup in the quarterfinal. Although Seth Jarvis could become a healthy scratch again, Montreal Canadiens captain Nick Suzuki could be another option, but not because of his play.

item.title: Sharks Place Jeff Skinner On NHL Waivers To Terminate Contract
item.description: The San Jose Sharks and Jeff Skinner are parting ways midway through a one-year contract.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey Power Rankings: Canada And U.S. Lead, Slovakia Impress
item.description: Canada, the United States and Slovakia clinched their groups in men's Olympic hockey, while Finland rebounded well after an opening loss.

item.title: France's Hockey Federation Suspends Pierre Crinon, Who Fought Canada's Tom Wilson, For Rest Of Olympics
item.description: The French Ice Hockey Federation said it won't allow Pierre Crinon to play Team France's qualification playoff game or any other, should it advance, due to his behavior on and off the ice.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In Men's Olympic Hockey: Slafkovsky And McDavid On Fire, Hertl Yet To Score
item.description: Oilers, Sharks and Canadiens players are dominating at the Olympics, while some players on Team USA and Team Czechia are struggling.

item.title: Can Anyone – Or Anything – Stop Canada Record-Breaker Marie-Philip Poulin?
item.description: Marie-Philip Poulin is playing hurt and still scored Canada's only goals in a tighter-than-expected semifinal win over Switzerland. After breaking a Team Canada record, can she come in clutch against the dominant Americans?

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Predicting Each Qualification Playoff Matchup
item.description: The men's hockey tournament at the 2026 Winter Olympics now has its qualifying games set. Will we see underdog teams pulling off upsets? Let's predict the results.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: USA, Canada To Meet In Olympic Women's Hockey Final
item.description: Andrew McInnis, Michael Augello, Chris Sinclair and Ryan Kennedy react to Team USA and Canada's semifinal wins before previewing the highly anticipated medal day.
